purpose: 캐릭터 선택창 디자인 비교용 모크업, 실제 게임 미적용

concepts.name: 01 붉은 달의 쌍문
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished landscape 16:9 full-screen character selection game UI mockup for the existing game "Lunatic Nights". This is a proposed UI screenshot, not a poster, not a device mockup. Reference image 1 is the CURRENT MAIN MENU, used as art direction and character identity reference ONLY. Preserve its exact visual language: intricate hand-inked dark fantasy engraved comic illustration, bold black crosshatching, vermilion blood moon, charcoal near-black stone and smoke, muted bone ivory serif typography, restrained tarnished bronze ornamental borders, small crimson diamond selection indicators. Black armored knight Barel has a fully enclosed angular black helm with narrow red eye slit, jagged shoulders, red tattered cape, greatsword. Viesa is the long crimson-haired pointed-ear female archer in dark fitted armor with aged gold leaf ornament, bow and quiver. Match their identities and outfits to the reference. Two playable heroes only, neither locked nor coming soon. Both must be visible as selectable options, Barel selected. Clear UI hierarchy, deliberate negative space, comfortable legibility, tasteful fine borders, minimal text. Avoid glossy mobile game styling, bright gold, blue neon, 3D render, photorealism, modern rounded dashboard cards, invented progression systems, detailed fictional stats, additional characters. Use exact Korean copy when specified, carefully legible. Visible title "캐릭터 선택", hero names "바렐", "비에사", roles "흑기사", "궁수", primary action "여정 시작", back action "돌아가기". Small subdued game wordmark "Lunatic Nights". Bottom keyboard hint "← → 선택 · Enter 확인 · Esc 돌아가기". No marketing copy. CONCEPT 01 — BLOOD MOON DIPTYCH. A symmetrical gothic double-arch diptych occupies the center 76% width, two tall large art windows side by side. Barel full-body selected in left arch, Viesa full-body unselected in right arch, both strongly readable. A huge shared red moon is faintly visible behind both arches. Selected left frame glows dark crimson with a small red diamond at top, unselected right frame is worn muted iron. Not trading cards: architectural arches, substantial illustration areas, restrained corner filigree. Header centered at top, character names in ivory on clean dark nameplates under their arches. Small roles below. Low bottom action row with subdued back button left, prominent long crimson "여정 시작" button right. Background smoky ruined castle, ornate but uncluttered. Most direct stylistic continuation of main menu. Put small concept number "01" in upper right margin.
